name: codex-execution-guard
description: Control and execute one bounded Codex implementation iteration.

interface.shortDescription: Create or reuse one guarded Codex execution task.
interface.longDescription: Route approved work into the correct native Codex task, persist its worktree ownership and real Git baseline, preserve stable execution across compaction, and return an evidence-based local receipt.
defaultPrompt: Use $execution-guard to create or reuse one task and implement this approved plan.
Resume this approved iteration with $execution-guard without changing its scope.
